snippet.title: Jolly Match 3 MR - Official Gameplay Trailer [ Indie-Credible Showcase 2026 ]
snippet.description:
Match 3 MR isn’t just a match-3 game - it’s built for mixed reality, turning your space into a colorful, interactive puzzle playground. Swap tiles, trigger combos, and unlock miniature islands inspired by iconic cities. Place the board anywhere, scale it, and interact using hand tracking or controllers. With quirky visuals, boosters, daily surprises, and family-friendly fun, every session is a fresh experience.
